chain.title: Crush Coal into Nuggets
chain.desc: One coal splits into eight Coal Nuggets. Half the pet recipes in the mod are built out of nuggets, so keep a stack on hand rather than crafting them one at a time.

chain.title: Craft the Furnace Pet
chain.desc: Sitting in your inventory it smelts the first smeltable item in your hotbar, so ore cooks while you keep mining. One is all you ever need.

chain.title: Sew a Feed Bag
chain.desc: Every pet gets hungry and stops working when it is. Fill this with food and it feeds your whole collection automatically - build it before you own more than two pets.

chain.title: Craft the Chest Pet
chain.desc: A chest's worth of storage that lives in one inventory slot and opens with a right click. The backbone of any mining trip.

chain.title: Craft the Crafting Table Pet
chain.desc: Opens a 3x3 grid anywhere, including mid-cave and mid-Nether. One is enough.

chain.title: Craft the Grave Pet
chain.desc: When you die it hands your inventory back to you instead of leaving it on the floor. Costs no diamonds, so make it early and never leave home without it.

chain.title: Split a Diamond
chain.desc: Nine Diamond Nuggets per diamond. They are the upgrade currency for sated pets and the Pingot, so expect to convert several diamonds over the course of the mod.

chain.title: Upgrade to a Sated Chest Pet
chain.desc: Same storage as the Chest Pet but it never gets hungry, so it keeps working when your Feed Bag runs dry. Worth doing for the pets you carry permanently.

chain.title: Craft the Bed Pet
chain.desc: Skips the night and sets your spawn without placing a bed, and can summon a Living Bed that walks around. One is plenty.

chain.title: Craft the Loot Pet
chain.desc: Adds bonus drops to mobs you kill and blocks you mine. It refuses to work on tools enchanted with Fortune, Looting or Silk Touch, so pair it with a plain pickaxe.

chain.title: Craft the Pingot Pet
chain.desc: Pings for the nearest ore and yanks it to you, and when no ore is close it names and points toward whichever of the mod's six hidden dungeons is nearby. This is how you find them.

chain.title: Find an Underground Dungeon
chain.desc: A mossy stone-brick vault buried under swamps, caves and mushroom fields, guarded by a Stone Spawner and holding chests. The Pingot Pet will tell you when one is in range.

chain.title: Grind Obsidian into Nuggets
chain.desc: The gate on the teleport pets - Enderman, Nether Portal and the Enchanting Table Pet all want these. Nine nuggets go back into a full obsidian block if you overshoot.

chain.title: Craft the Enderman Pet
chain.desc: Right click to blink to whatever you are looking at, and it will teleport you out of danger on its own if a hit would drop you below half a heart. The single best survival pet.

chain.title: Craft the Nether Portal Pet
chain.desc: Drops you into the Nether and returns you to the exact spot you left, no obsidian frame required. Handy for quick blaze powder and quartz runs.

chain.title: Crumble Ender Pearls
chain.desc: Ender Nuggets feed the Ender Chest Pet, the House Pet and the End Portal Pet. Kill endermen or trade with a cleric for the pearls.

chain.title: Craft the Ender Chest Pet
chain.desc: Your ender chest in a single slot, so a base sorting system is one right click away wherever you are standing.

chain.title: Craft the End Portal Pet
chain.desc: Needs an eye of ender, and afterwards takes you to the End and back on demand. Only useful once you have already beaten or at least reached the End.

chain.title: Craft the Saddle Pet
chain.desc: Lets you ride essentially any mob you right click, saddle or not. It is also the base for the flying version, so do not lose it.

chain.title: Upgrade to the Flying Saddle Pet
chain.desc: Eight diamonds around the Saddle Pet. Now whatever you are riding flies, and you can float down safely when you dismount high up.

chain.title: Craft the Wither Pet
chain.desc: The first Legendary, paid for with a nether star. Damage you deal heals you, wither effect stops mattering, and it shoots skulls on command.

chain.title: Craft the Petrifier
chain.desc: Consumes a Legendary pet and eight gold to make. It turns a block or a living mob into a statue, and every use costs you - a diamond for a block, a nether star for a mob - so treat it as a decoration tool rather than a weapon.

chain.title: Fuse Three Pets into a Meta Pet
chain.desc: Any three pets combine into one item that transforms into whichever pet you need at the moment. The endgame answer to running out of hotbar space.

notes: Progression derived from data/inventorypets/recipes (105 files), the mod's own 103-advancement tree, and data/inventorypets/tags/items/*_pets.json which define the categories the advancements group pets by. The mod is deliberately wide rather than deep: almost every pet is a one-step craft of diamond + gold + a themed ingredient in the same OFO/ODO/OGO ring, so the real ordering axis is the tier of the themed ingredient (coal/cobble -> obsidian/quartz -> ender pearl -> nether star) plus the mod's own nugget items. Every pet gets hungry and stops working; inventorypets:feed_bag auto-feeds them and inventorypets:pet_sated_chest / pet_sated_double_chest are the never-hungry upgrades - this is the mechanic new players miss, so it is step 3. Six structures exist and all contain chests: inventorypets:code_structure_underground_dungeon, code_structure_sky_dungeon, code_structure_sea_cave, code_structure_nether_dungeon, code_structure_space_dungeon, code_structure_tree_top; the Pingot Pet is the intended locator for them (see info.pingot.* lang keys). Holiday pets (pet_christmas_tree, pet_menorah, pet_mishumaa_saba, pet_politically_correct) only work Dec 14-25 and pet_april_fool only in April, so they are collection-only and must never be a required quest. inventorypets:pet_custom, the petachieve_* icons and the windows_*/xerox_parc_gui/start_button scavenger-hunt props have no recipe. patreon_head and patreon_shirt are Patreon-gated. nugget_lapis has only the dirt+lapis variant recipe (nugget_lapis_alt); the plain one is absent from this build.
